sources.title: ONNX Model Zoo
sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. sources.title: microsoft-deberta-v3-small | Model Catalog | Microsoft Foundry
sources.snippet: The DeBERTa V3 small model comes with 6 layers and a hidden size of 768. It has 44M backbone parameters with a vocabulary containing 128K tokens which introduces 98M parameters in the Embedding layer. This model was trained using the 160GB data as DeBERTa V2. Fine-tuning on NLU tasks We present the dev results on SQuAD 2.0 and MNLI tasks.
